workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Both busy entire slot
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both busy (Elena: Hiring panel, David: Travel)
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David busy entire slot (Elena free 15:00-15:30 only)
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both busy entire slot

However, here are the times when BOTH Elena and David are free (potential 30-min slots):
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 9:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 9:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Could you check Priya and Marcus's calendars for these times? If any of these work for all four, I'll confirm and we can book it.
